summary: Comprehensive testing of Place of Beauty Polish beauty salon website completed successfully. All backend APIs working, frontend navigation functional, mobile responsive, and Booksy integration verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Button click intercepted by Emergent badge overlay

Home page loads with hero section, navigation, features bar, services preview, reviews marquee, CTA section, info bar
Navigation links work for all pages: /, /uslugi, /o-nas, /galeria, /opinie, /kontakt
Services page loads and displays service categories with search and filter functionality
Gallery page loads with images and lightbox opens/closes correctly
Reviews page loads with customer testimonials and rating summary (4.9/5, 272 reviews)
Contact page loads with address, phone, hours, and Google Maps iframe
About page loads with salon info, values, team, and amenities
All Booksy buttons link to correct URL: https://booksy.com/pl-pl/103643_place-of-beauty-carika_paznokcie_4424_grodzisk-mazowiecki
Mobile navigation menu opens and closes properly
Polish language content displays correctly throughout the site

success_percentage.frontend: 98% (minor scroll button issue due to overlay)
